name: currency-mismatch-cad
description: The shop quotes in Canadian dollars. The pipeline must record the stated currency and add a currency_mismatch warning so the quote is never silently compared against USD quotes.

transcript.message: Hi, this is WrenchBid, an AI assistant calling on behalf of a customer. I need an itemized quote for a confirmed scope: 2020 Toyota Camry SE, 62,000 miles, replace front brake pads and rotors with premium aftermarket parts, completion within 7 days.
We can do that. Parts $410, labor $300, shop supplies $40, diagnostic and disposal are $0, and tax $65.50 — heads up, that's in Canadian dollars.
Understood — I'll record the quote in Canadian dollars so it is never mixed with US-dollar quotes. Please confirm the final all-in total, warranty, earliest appointment, and how long the quote holds.
All-in $815.50 Canadian, warranty 12 months, earliest Thursday, good for 10 days.
Confirmed: $815.50 Canadian all-in with the 12 months warranty. I'll present that exact quote and its currency to the customer.
